description: Searches the product catalogs of curated independent online stores, chosen for the quality of their catalogs, for products that match the request. It fits requests to find, compare or choose products, such as "find me waterproof hiking boots under $200", gift ideas, or a specific product type or brand. Unlike a general web search, it returns products rather than web pages: each result is one product with its name, the store that sells it, its price and currency, whether it is in stock, an image, and a direct link to its page on the store's own website. Store catalogs are kept constantly refreshed, so prices and stock are up to date. Shop Nobi sells nothing itself: the user buys from the store. Links carry UTM tags that tell the store the visit came from Shop Nobi. When a product's linkLabel is set, such as "We may earn a commission", show it next to that product's link.

limit.description: How many products to return, from 1 to 20. The default is 10.

query.description: What the user is looking for, in plain words, with the details that matter to them, such as "waterproof hiking boots" or "linen dress for a summer wedding under $150".

name: search_products
title: Search products across independent stores
